rules.R1: Red-flag symptom reported -> escalate to health worker now
rules.R2: Danger word said with negation -> ask one confirmation question
rules.R3: Patient stopped treatment -> 'complete the course' + flag worker
rules.R0: Patient asked to hear the question again -> replay it (once per question, max 2 per call); not counted as an answer
rules.R3a: Patient asked whether to stop the medicine (no reassurance template answers it) -> 'please continue' + flag worker
rules.R4: Dose still unclear after one follow-up -> flag worker
rules.R5: Dose unclear (first time) -> ask one follow-up
rules.R5b: Hesitant 'yes' (filler words / long pause) -> one probe about recent missed doses; an unsure yes is never recorded as-is
rules.R6a: Probe revealed recently missed doses -> acknowledge + flag worker
rules.R6b: Non-red symptom needing review (vomiting once, pain, tingling, unconfirmed) -> flag worker
rules.R6c: Evon second-listener raised a concern the rules did not -> human review
rules.R7: Harmless, expected side effect -> approved reassurance + log
rules.R8: Dose taken, no problems -> thank + log
rules.R9: Low confidence somewhere in the call -> never green, flag worker
rules.F1: Family contact reports danger sign -> escalate
rules.F2: Family contact reached; patient unreachable -> home visit / follow-up
rules.X1: No answer -> retry in 2 hours (max 2 attempts)
rules.X2: Two unanswered attempts -> call family contact
rules.X3: Three consecutive days without confirmed dose -> home visit needed

kn-IN.symptom_ack: ಸರಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ತೊಂದರೆಯನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಯಕರ್ತೆ ಇವತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಮಾತ್ರೆ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿ.
kn-IN.probe_dose: ಸರಿ. ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ, ಕಳೆದ ಮೂರು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದಾದರೂ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ತಪ್ಪಿಹೋಗಿತ್ತಾ? ಹೌದು ಅಥವಾ ಇಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿ.
kn-IN.red_advice: ನಾನು ಇದನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಯಕರ್ತೆಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ದೇನೆ, ಅವರು ಇವತ್ತೇ ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ತುಂಬಾ ಹುಷಾರಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಹತ್ತಿರದ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಅಥವಾ ನೂರ ಎಂಟಕ್ಕೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿ.
kn-IN.thanks: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು, ನಾಳೆ ಇದೇ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮಾತನಾಡೋಣ.
kn-IN.family_check: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು ಖುರಾಕ್, {name} ಅವರ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರದಿಂದ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದರೂ ಅವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಲು ಆಗಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಅವರು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದ್ದಾರಾ, ಮಾತ್ರೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರಾ?
kn-IN.family_close: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು. ಈ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕಾರ್ಯಕರ್ತೆಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ದೇನೆ, ಅವರು ಬೇಗ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

english.greeting: Hello {name}, this is Khurak calling from your health centre.
english.ask_dose: Did you take today's TB medicine?
english.followup_dose: Sorry, I didn't quite understand. Did you take your medicine today? Please say yes or no.
english.ask_symptoms: Any problems? Like vomiting, stomach pain, or yellowness in the eyes?
english.confirm_symptom: Just to confirm, do you have {symptom}? Please say yes or no.
english.reassure_orange_urine: Orange or red urine is caused by this medicine. It is normal. Don't worry, keep taking it.
english.reassure_mild_nausea: Mild nausea is common. Try taking the tablets after food. If you vomit repeatedly, tell us.
english.reassure_tiredness: Some tiredness early on is common. Rest and keep taking the medicine.
english.complete_course: Great that you feel better! But completing the full TB course is essential, or the disease can come back and the medicine can stop working. Your health worker will talk to you.
english.missed_ack: Okay, I've noted it. Your health worker will talk to you.
english.unclear_close: No problem. Your health worker will talk to you today.
english.symptom_ack: Okay, I've noted your problem. Your health worker will talk to you today. Please continue the medicine.
english.probe_dose: Okay. Just to be sure, did you miss any dose in the last three days? Please say yes or no.
english.red_advice: I've informed your health worker; she will contact you today. If you feel much worse, go to the nearest hospital or call 108 immediately.
english.thanks: Very good! Thank you, we'll talk again tomorrow at the same time.
english.family_check: Hello, this is Khurak from {name}'s health centre. We couldn't reach them after two tries. Are they okay and taking their medicine?
english.family_close: Thank you. I've passed this to the health worker; she will contact you soon.
